headline: SEA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.13 at CLE 4.03, with a projected total of 8.16. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Julio Rodríguez, Travis Bazzana, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Fry, Daniel Schneemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
